meta.source: Norrin pitch deck slides 1 to 9, and the scored look book (style A, 61/65)
meta.reference: Deck px values are at a 1280x720 reference. Multiply by 0.75 for python-pptx points.

tokens.name: paper-000
tokens.usage: Slide ground and page ground. The deck is paper first: every slide body sits on this.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Inset ground for a machine block or a code fence, one step off paper-000.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Headlines and the claim line. Text on paper-000.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary prose, the sub line under a headline. Text on paper-000.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and field labels, always uppercase and letterspaced. Text on paper-000.

tokens.name: rule-200
tokens.usage: Hairline rules. This system separates with rules, never with boxes or shadows.

tokens.name: band-public
tokens.usage: Banner band fill for a page labelled public. Carries band-ink text.

tokens.name: band-confidential
tokens.usage: Banner band fill for a page labelled confidential. Carries band-ink text.

tokens.name: band-restricted
tokens.usage: Banner band fill for a page labelled restricted. Carries band-ink text.

tokens.name: band-ink
tokens.usage: Text on any band-* fill. White in both themes, which is why the band fills stay dark in both.

tokens.name: text-public
tokens.usage: The word public set as text on paper. Lighter in the dark theme, where the band fill would fail as text.

tokens.name: text-confidential
tokens.usage: The word confidential set as text on paper, and the emphasis in a claim line.

tokens.name: text-restricted
tokens.usage: The word restricted set as text on paper, and any path the agent tried to reach.

tokens.name: signal-refuse
tokens.usage: The refusal glyph and refusal text in machine output. Alias: a refusal is the restricted colour, never a fourth red.

tokens.name: signal-allow
tokens.usage: The success glyph in machine output. Alias: an allow is the public colour.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: The classification band, top and bottom of every slide. Uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrow above a headline. Uppercase, ink-400.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: One claim per slide, sentence case, never uppercase.
styles.sample: The label lives on the folder

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: The qualifier under a headline, ink-600, at most two lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field label over a hairline, uppercase, ink-400.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: A path, a level, a JSON fragment: anything quoted from a file.

styles.name: kick
styles.usage: The consequence line at the foot of a slide, above the bottom band.

styles.name: machine
styles.usage: Verbatim terminal output. Never retyped or tidied.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: The product's own footer status line, reproduced exactly.

styles.name: cover-name
styles.usage: The repository name on the GitHub banner. Mono, because it is an identifier.

styles.name: cover-tag
styles.usage: One sentence under the name on the banner, ink-600.

styles.name: cover-banner
styles.usage: The marking band across the top of the GitHub banner image.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Title of a report, memo or spec built in this system.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Running prose, kept near 65 characters a line.

styles.name: doc-meta
styles.usage: Byline, date, marking line. Uppercase, ink-400.

styles.name: doc-code
styles.usage: Inline and fenced code in a document.

spacing.note: Px at the 1280x720 deck reference. Multiply by 0.75 for points in python-pptx. The scale is deliberately open: the gutter is 5 percent of the slide width, because a projected page reads as crowded long before a screen does.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its hairline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Band padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text lines in a field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Headline to sub, and rule to kick.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The slide gutter, left and right, at 5 percent of the slide width. Bands run full bleed through it.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gap between two fields on a slide.

radius.note: The deck is square. Radius exists for web and GitHub surfaces only.

tokens.name: radius-flat
tokens.usage: Every slide element, every band, every field. The default.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: A level chip or badge on a web surface.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: A code fence or card on a web surface, matching GitHub's own 6px.

shadow.note: One shadow, for showing a slide on a web page. Never inside a slide.

tokens.name: shadow-web
tokens.usage: A slide thumbnail sitting on a web page.
